description: Say one short line where you stand, shown above your figure for a short while: plain text in Latin letters, up to 80 characters, with no links, addresses, product names or orders to others. One line every 15 seconds. A line that breaks a rule is refused with the reason. The site can switch speech off.

text.description: One line of plain text, up to 80 characters once cleaned.

name: world_say
title: Say a line
